title: CNOS-BEN International Day of Sport for Development and Peace march, Porto-Novo
exclusion_reason: The opened CNOS-BEN account describes an officially promoted sports-for-development-and-peace march and reports no demand addressed to the Beninese government or its policy. It does not meet the protest demand criterion; do not code merely because the march was public and sizable.
notes: The report's 'strong participation' is not numerically quantified. This exclusion rests on the reported purpose/target, not on an attendance estimate.
